name: Hero Carousel Pro
description: A stunning, fully animated hero carousel with autoplay, touch support, and smooth transitions. Perfect for landing pages and marketing sites.
longDescription: Hero Carousel Pro is a premium animated carousel built for React and Next.js. It supports autoplay, keyboard navigation, touch gestures, and fully customizable slide content. Comes with 5 animation variants including fade, slide, scale, and flip.

name: Dashboard Analytics
description: Complete analytics dashboard with charts, stats cards, recent activity feed, and real-time data visualizations built with Recharts.
longDescription: A production-ready analytics dashboard that includes line charts, bar charts, pie charts, KPI cards, activity feeds, and data tables. Built with Recharts and fully responsive.

name: Auth System Complete
description: Full authentication system with login, register, forgot password, OTP verification, and social OAuth. Includes form validation and error handling.
longDescription: A complete authentication solution including Login, Register, Forgot Password, Reset Password, and OTP verification screens. Supports Google, GitHub OAuth and includes Zod validation.

name: Data Table Advanced
description: Feature-rich data table with sorting, filtering, pagination, row selection, and bulk actions. Built with TanStack Table v8.
longDescription: Advanced data table component using TanStack Table v8. Supports virtual scrolling for large datasets, multi-column sorting, global and column filtering, pagination, row selection with bulk actions.

name: E-commerce Product Card
description: Beautiful product card with image gallery, wishlist, quick-view modal, size selector, color swatches, and add-to-cart animation.
longDescription: A complete e-commerce product card component with image gallery, zoom on hover, wishlist toggle, quick view modal, size and color selection, and smooth add-to-cart animation.

name: Rich Text Editor
description: A powerful rich text editor with toolbar, markdown support, image upload, code blocks, and real-time preview. Built with TipTap.
longDescription: Full-featured rich text editor built on TipTap. Supports headings, bold, italic, lists, blockquotes, code blocks with syntax highlighting, image upload, link insertion, and markdown shortcuts.

name: Notification System
description: Complete notification system with toast alerts, notification center, badge counts, and real-time updates. Multiple positions and styles.
longDescription: A comprehensive notification system including toast notifications, a notification center dropdown, unread badge count, and real-time simulation. Supports success, error, warning, and info types.

name: Pricing Table SaaS
description: Stunning SaaS pricing table with monthly/annual toggle, feature comparison, highlighted plan, and smooth animations.
longDescription: A conversion-optimized SaaS pricing table with monthly/annual billing toggle, 3 plans, feature comparison rows, a popular plan badge, and CTA buttons. Fully animated with Framer Motion.

name: File Upload Drag & Drop
description: Beautiful drag-and-drop file upload with preview, progress bar, file type validation, and multiple file support.
longDescription: A sleek file upload component with drag-and-drop zone, file preview (images, PDFs, docs), upload progress bar, file type and size validation, and multi-file support.
